title: Rabbi Taddai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 35b: “Rabbi Abba said that Rabbi Taddai said.”
There, at 38b: “Rabbi Ami said: Rabbi Taddai acted for himself.”
In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:8: Rabbi Simon, Rabbi Taddai in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua [ben Levi].

In Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:1: Rabbi Simon deTarei; the reading of Yuchasin HaShalem is Rabbi Simon bar Taddai. Hyman considers it undoubtedly originally written “b״r,” meaning “in the name of Rabbi Taddai.” There is also Rabbi Elazar ben Taddai: Shabbat 123b.
Rabbi Yose ben Taddai: Derekh Eretz Rabbah, beginning of chapter 1.

notes.text: The consulted Shabbat 38b contains both Rabbi Abba’s transmission from Rabbi Taddai and Rabbi Ami’s remark. Hyman places the first at 35b. His locator and proposed Yuchasin abbreviation reconstruction are preserved; no printed-page verification is claimed.
